coordinates: x,y from top,width,height; safe-area content root
verticalOffset: max(-80,(logicalViewportHeight-1920)/2); apply to sprites, text and hit regions together
contentColumn: phones fill safe width; tablet proof has 520px column in 768px screen; host use existing shared responsive root
touchTargets: minimum 48dp at 360px content width; expand Close to144 reference px; restrict focus to modal
shortWindows: scroll cream body; keep title/close/footer accessible; do not shrink all text below design sizes
longNames: two visual lines, ellipsis at word/grapheme boundary only after overflow; full name in accessible label
underlay: actual live member details, not a flattened screenshot; native proof reconstructs approved R4 layout
back: before commit Cancel; pending or unknown Close without cancelling operation; return focus to caller
